decl_lean_note: As written in the file, up to the start of its proof. The file's variable lines apply to it.
key_statements_text: As a sample, only the three files of the group "From a one-sided bound to the zeros" open to the statements Lean checks one by one. Each box is one named statement or definition, in the file's order; its note is the repository's own, where it has one. A line joins two statements of the same file: the upper one uses the lower one. Proofs are not opened, except in an AI agent's reading, marked as ours, which a few statements carry; on the others you can ask your own AI assistant for one.

decl_prompt_copied: Copied. Paste it into your AI assistant.

decl_reading_none: No AI agent's reading of this statement yet. You can ask your own AI assistant for one:
